name: solar-inverter-dashboard-docs
description: Compodoc documentation toolchain for the Solar Inverter Dashboard project

scripts.docs:generate: compodoc -p tsconfig.doc.json -d documentation --includes docs --includesName "Project Guide" --name "Solar Inverter Dashboard" --theme readthedocs --disablePrivate --disableProtected --disableInternal --disableSourceCode
scripts.docs:serve: compodoc -p tsconfig.doc.json -d documentation --includes docs --includesName "Project Guide" --name "Solar Inverter Dashboard" --theme readthedocs --disablePrivate --disableProtected --disableInternal --disableSourceCode --serve --port 8081
